topics.title: Water resources of India and surface water
topics.ncert_sections: Water Resources of India; Surface Water Resources

concepts.learning_objective: Recall and calculate India's total, available and utilisable water resources.
Explain the uneven spatial distribution and limited utilisation of surface water across river basins.
Compare the levels of groundwater utilisation among Indian states.
Describe the coastal lagoons and backwaters as a surface water resource and their uses.

topics.title: Water demand, utilisation and irrigation
topics.ncert_sections: Water Demand and Utilisation; Demand of Water for Irrigation; PMKSY

concepts.learning_objective: Compare the shares of agriculture, industry and domestic sectors in surface and groundwater use.
Explain why irrigation is needed in India and analyse the effects of its intensive use on groundwater.
State the vision and objectives of the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana.

topics.title: Emerging water problems and prevention of water pollution
topics.ncert_sections: Emerging Water Problems; Deterioration of Water Quality; Prevention of Water Pollution

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what water quality means and how pollutants deteriorate it.
Identify severely polluted rivers and evaluate legal and public measures to control water pollution.

topics.title: Water conservation, recycling and watershed management
topics.ncert_sections: Water Conservation and Management; Recycle and Reuse of Water; Watershed Management

concepts.learning_objective: Give examples of how water of lesser quality can be recycled and reused.
Explain the meaning and aims of watershed management.
Analyse community-based watershed programmes such as Haryali, Neeru-Meeru and Ralegan Siddhi.

topics.title: Rainwater harvesting and national water initiatives
topics.ncert_sections: Rainwater Harvesting; National Water Policy 2012; Jal Kranti Abhiyan

concepts.learning_objective: Describe methods and benefits of rainwater harvesting.
Interpret the salient features of India's National Water Policy, 2012.
State the aims and proposed activities of the Jal Kranti Abhiyan.
